title: Released government reports of UFOs over Savannah River, Oak Ridge and Los Alamos
place_text: Savannah River facility; Oak Ridge National Laboratory; Los Alamos

tellings.quote: when you look in there you see actual verbatim UFO incidents back in the 50s and 60s over the pH Savannah River facility y over what Oakridge National Laboratory over what Los Alamos

plain: In the 1950s and 1960s, UFOs were reported over some of America's most sensitive nuclear sites: the Savannah River facility in South Carolina, Oak Ridge National Laboratory in Tennessee, and Los Alamos in New Mexico. A former Pentagon intelligence officer named Luis Elizondo says these are written up verbatim in roughly 10,000 government reports that have been released, and that anyone who looks in them will find these incidents. If true, it would mean the government has long known about UFOs hovering over its nuclear work.
